corpus: QuixBugs (github.com/jkoppel/QuixBugs @ 4257f44): 40 single-defect Python programs; the 31 with JSON I/O cases are usable

protocol.given_to_capability: every failing case + up to 2 passing cases as plain pytest asserts
protocol.held_out: the remaining cases; CORRECT = the shipped diff passes every usable case of the program (reference-consistent, non-hanging)

caveats: The templates added in this pass (NAME_OFFSET, NAME_REPLACE, ARG_SWAP, CALL_UNWRAP, SLICE_INSERT, [] -> [[]], max(0, _), append-after-loop, Add operand order) were derived from the misses of run 1 on this same corpus: these numbers measure coverage of QuixBugs' one-line fix patterns, not blind generalisation.

CORRECT means every usable case of the program passes; several shipped patches are equivalent to, not identical with, the reference fix (find_first_in_sorted `hi = len(arr[1:])`, lcs_length `dp[i, j + 1]`, is_valid_parenthesization's synthesized condition).
bitcount and sqrt are excluded: every failing case hangs and the real-pytest reproduce has no per-test timeout; hanoi is excluded: the reference returns tuples where the JSON cases hold lists.
Programs without JSON cases (9 of 40) are not run.

review (this pass): after the gate, the gate's own mutation operators on the `+` lines of each shipped diff were judged in-process and the changed lines' coverage read from the traced spectrum -- 0 surviving mutants and 0 uncovered changed lines across the 28 repairs, type gate PASS_BASELINE_ONLY on every program because this host has no mypy; `wrap` ships `lines.append(text)`, which has no mutable site (kill_ratio null). An earlier measurement that counted hunk context lines and capped the spectrum at 500 rows reported 1 survivor and 3 uncovered lines; both were artefacts and are fixed.

the previous pass's run of this corpus (before hosted pytest and the review step): 28/28 CORRECT, 292 s total, median 5.7 s, max 31.8 s; this run: 28/28 CORRECT, 319.7 s, median 6.03 s, max 39.7 s -- the review step costs 0.37-0.40 s per program; the rest of the difference is host variance (levenshtein 31.8 -> 39.7 s on the same code path).

summary.given_to_capability: every failing case + at most 2 passing; the rest held out
summary.verdict_law: PLAUSIBLE = the capability's own gate passed; CORRECT = plausible AND every held-out case passes on the patched program; neither is proof
